# gfsR

The package contains a suite of tools helpful for working with FishNet2
data files. The primary functions provide a convenient way of unzipping
`DATA.ZIP` archive files and reading them directly in to the R working
environment.

The most up to date version can be installed using:
`devtools::install_github("HoldenJe/gfsR")`

## Contributions

Contributions from users are welcomed. Please review [CONTRIBUTING
Guidelines](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/CONTRIBUTING.md) for work
flow instructions.

## Examples

- Creel data archive  
  `creel <- import_fn_creel("~/FNData/WCH/SF18_WCH/DATA.ZIP")`  
  `lapply(creel, head)`

- Index Netting Project  
  `nscin <- import_fn_index_net("~/FNData/NS1/IA02_NS1/DATA.ZIP")`  
  `lapply(nscin, head)`

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## See also:

`rprocval`: tools for checking data structure and biological
attributes  
<https://github.com/HoldenJe/rprocval>

[Fishnet Migration
Manual](https://fishnetmigration.github.io/FN2DataMigrationManual/) -
*an ongoing work-in-progress*

# Package index

## All functions

- [`All_FN_Tables()`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/All_FN_Tables.md)
  : All_FN_Tables
- [`SILOC2COORD()`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/SILOC2COORD.md)
  : Convert XSILOC1 FN2 Field to LAT and LON fields
- [`SILOCgetLAT10()`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/SILOCgetLAT10.md)
  : Parses LAT from a 10 character SILOC
- [`SILOCgetLAT12()`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/SILOCgetLAT12.md)
  : Parses LAT from a 12 character SILOC
- [`SILOCgetLON10()`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/SILOCgetLON10.md)
  : Parses LON from a 10 characterSILOC
- [`SILOCgetLON12()`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/SILOCgetLON12.md)
  : Parses LON from a 12 character SILOC
- [`SpcName`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/SpcName.md) :
  Species Codes, Common Names and Species Labels
- [`append.spc.names()`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/append.spc.names.md)
  : Append Species Names
- [`area.cue()`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/area.cue.md)
  : area.cue
- [`fill.CATCNT()`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/fill.CATCNT.md)

  : fix_date

- [`fl.rwt()`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/fl.rwt.md) :
  fl.rwt
- [`gl1.vartypes()`](https://holdenje.github.io/gfsR/reference/gl1.vartypes.md)
  : Assign GL1 FN121 variable types
